standard_prerequisites.name: Projective space as Proj of a polynomial ring with its standard opens
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter derham.tex, the discussion preceding the lemma (used at proof lines 1602-1617)
standard_prerequisites.use: It fixes $\mathbf{P}^n_A = \operatorname{Proj}(A[T_0, \ldots, T_n])$ and the standard opens $D_+(T_i) = \Spec(A[T_0/T_i, \ldots, T_n/T_i])$ on which the maps are written.

standard_prerequisites.name: The tautological quotient and the identifications of $\mathcal{O}(-1)$ and $\mathcal{O}$ on the standard opens
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter derham.tex, the description of the relevant invertible sheaves used at proof lines 1606-1608 and 1624
standard_prerequisites.use: They let $\mathcal{O}(-1)^{\oplus n+1}$ be written as $\bigoplus_j \mathcal{O}(-1)\mathrm{d}T_j$ and make sense of the coefficients $1/T_i$ and $T_j$ appearing in the two maps.

core_obligations: Recall the presentations of projective space and of the sheaf $\mathcal{O}(-1)^{\oplus n+1}$ as $\bigoplus_j \mathcal{O}(-1)\mathrm{d}T_j$, in which the two maps of the sequence are described (proof lines 1602-1608).

Write down the first map $\Omega \to \bigoplus_j \mathcal{O}(-1)\mathrm{d}T_j$ on each standard open $D_+(T_i)$ by the displayed rule sending $g_j\,\mathrm{d}(T_j/T_i)$ to $g_j/T_i\,\mathrm{d}T_j - (\sum_j g_jT_j/T_i^2)\mathrm{d}T_i$, and note that it makes sense because $1/T_i$ is a section of $\mathcal{O}(-1)$ (proof lines 1609-1624).

Write down the second map $\bigoplus_j \mathcal{O}(-1)\mathrm{d}T_j \to \mathcal{O}$ as the one sending $\mathrm{d}T_j$ to $T_j$, i.e. $\sum_j g_j\mathrm{d}T_j \mapsto \sum_j T_jg_j$ on $D_+(T_i)$ (proof lines 1625-1633).
Note that the verification that the two maps form a short exact sequence is left to the reader, the constructions being the content of the proof (proof lines 1633-1634).
proof_roadmap: The first map on the standard opens (proof lines 1609-1624).
difficulty_reason: The lemma is the Euler sequence on projective space, exhibiting $\Omega$ as the kernel of a surjection from a direct sum of twisted structure sheaves onto $\mathcal{O}$ (statement lines 1593-1599). The proof fixes the Proj presentation and writes both maps explicitly on each standard open, with the coefficients justified by the standard descriptions of the invertible sheaves involved; the verification of exactness is a routine check the author leaves to the reader. Spelling out the two maps is the substance, so the claim is H2.
